Liiga team stat tables

Source: R/liiga.R
liiga_team_stats.Rd

Team stat table of a season range, by data_type.

Usage

liiga_team_stats(
  data_type,
  season_from = NULL,
  season_to = NULL,
  tournament = "runkosarja"
)

Arguments

data_type

Stat table: shots, passes, faceoffs, penalties, powerplay, penalty_kill, even_strength.

season_from

First season (END year) of the range.

season_to

Last season (END year) of the range.

tournament

Tournament: runkosarja (regular season), playoffs, playout, qualifications, valmistavat_ottelut (preseason) or chl (Champions Hockey League). Required by the API; defaults to runkosarja.

Value

A fastRhockey_data tibble (67 columns; zero rows when a valid payload has none).

Details

Endpoint: GET https://liiga.fi/api/v2/teams/stats

Seasons are END years (2026 = 2025-26), the same key as sdv-py. Requests to liiga.fi are spaced at least one second apart. A request Liiga answers with nothing (an unknown game, a tournament not played that season, a shot map before 2016) raises fastRhockey_no_data; a failed fetch or an error-shaped answer raises fastRhockey_asset_fetch; a bad argument raises fastRhockey_bad_request.

The columns below are those of the default data_type; the other tables carry their own stat columns next to team_id / player_id.
